newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gold to stay in $380-383 range next week - Dresdner.
newsitem.headline: Gold to stay in $380-383 range next week - Dresdner.

text.p: Gold bullion was likely to maintain this week's $380-383 range per ounce over the next five trading days, Dresdner Bank said in its weekly precious metals report on Friday.
"We expect further, albeit slow, price increases only if it breaks above the top level," the bank wrote.
Temporary gold highs resulted in rising mark prices this week -- yesterday gold reached 585, the highest mark level since late June, the bank noted.
German private investors did not use this scenario for sales and instead increased their gold portfolios, but turnover was still comparatively thin.
Dresdner analysts saw the dollar poised to move higher, perhaps to 1.55 marks.
Should gold fail to break overhead resistance at $384, they recommended short-term sales at above 590 marks. -Vera Eckert, Hamburg newsroom, +49-40-41903275
